{{Top|leg}}
A [[Species/Legends|species]] of '''carnivorous fungi''' was native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]]. It was considered to be one of the more lethal lifeforms on the world that existed below the [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] canopy.<ref name="EGTPM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref>
